fields.name: root
fields.label: Root Path (Optional)
fields.description: Folder to pick articles from, e.g. /blogs/technology.

fields.name: index
fields.label: Query Index Path
fields.description: Index to read articles from, e.g. /news-index.json, or another site's full index URL (articles then link there; it must allow CORS).

fields.name: show
fields.label: Show
fields.description: Current Page Tags: articles sharing this page's tags (hidden when it has none). Latest articles: the newest from the Root Path.

fields.name: viewAll
fields.label: View All Link (Optional)
fields.description: Page the View all button opens, e.g. /newsroom. The button shows on the right of the heading only when this and the View All Label are both filled in.

fields.name: viewAllLabel
fields.label: View All Label (Optional)
fields.description: Text of the View all button, e.g. View all news. No button when empty.

fields.name: classes
fields.label: Style
fields.description: Center: heading centred over the cards. Left: eyebrow and heading on the left. View all always sits right of the heading.
